title: Warranty Service Standards by Program: Emergency Conditions, Response and Scheduling Times
content:
Warranty operations of the Calloway Limited Home Warranty run to five program figures: the conditions treated as emergencies, the hours from an emergency report within which a technician is dispatched, the business days from a non-emergency report within which the inspection is held, the calendar days from approval within which an approved repair is completed, and the calendar days the homeowner has to provide access once Calloway asks to schedule.

## Emergency conditions

| Program | Conditions treated as emergencies |
|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | no heat; total water loss; total electrical loss; active water leak; sewer backup; gas leak |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | no heat; total water loss; total electrical loss; active water leak; sewer backup; gas leak |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | no heat; total water loss; total electrical loss; active water leak; sewer backup; gas leak |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | no heat; no cooling; total water loss; total electrical loss; active water leak; sewer backup; gas leak |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | no heat; no cooling; total water loss; total electrical loss; active water leak; sewer backup; gas leak |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | no heat; no cooling; total water loss; total electrical loss; active water leak; sewer backup; gas leak |

## Time standards

| Program | Emergency response (hours from report to dispatch) | Inspection of a non-emergency item (business days from report) | Repair target (calendar days from approval) | Access response (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | 24 | 5 | 30 | 14 |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | 24 | 5 | 30 | 14 |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | 24 | 5 | 30 | 14 |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | 12 | 3 | 21 | 14 |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | 12 | 3 | 21 | 21 |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | 4 | 2 | 14 | 21 |

## Points of reading

- No cooling is an emergency condition only in HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred, HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier and HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve; in the three lower programs it is not on the list.
- The inspection standard is counted in business days; the repair target and the access response are counted in calendar days.
- Hypothetical illustration: an item approved for repair under HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred has a repair target of 21 calendar days from the approval.
